title: Gradient Descent & Optimizers — Remember the Recent Direction
key_insight: Momentum keeps a moving memory of recent gradients, smoothing the zigzag and carrying useful speed. Stochastic gradient descent estimates the direction from a batch rather than all data.
body:
## Remember the Recent Direction

Plain updates zigzag across a narrow valley. Progress is slow even though the downhill direction is broadly consistent.

Momentum keeps a moving memory of recent gradients, smoothing the zigzag and carrying useful speed. Stochastic gradient descent estimates the direction from a batch rather than all data.

Adam also keeps a separate scale for each parameter based on recent gradient sizes. It often starts easily, though SGD can still generalize better in some tasks.
common_mistakes: An optimizer creates training labels from nothing.
Weights should move in the direction that raises loss.
Momentum deletes all information from earlier steps.

real_world_usage: Backpropagation finds directions; the optimizer decides the actual size and pattern of every update.
